description: Taiwan - Wind Speed and Wind Power Potential Maps is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Albertine Potter van Loon (World Bank Group). Maps with wind speed, wind rose and wind power density potential in Taiwan. The GIS data stems from the Global Wind Atlas ( GIS data is available as JSON and CSV. The second link provides poster size (.pdf) and midsize maps (.png). Coverage: the whole world. It has 2 files in HTML. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
